up: Return the exact activity values and structures for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4513218. Include the molecule ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, standard type, relation, value, and units. Use the exact activity relation and value as recorded in the database.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM activities a
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4513218'
